name: Menace
author: ArraegenGD
description: Note: the secret way actually goes to 98%. Click the left side of the spider orb at 20% and immediately spam to get out of the level. Stay below the level until 80% where you have to go upwards and spam until the spam part ends. Reenter the level at the spider orbs part at the ending and continue playing until the end as ufo.
